text:
sophie: quick Q — ran into a weird client-visible quota case while testing per-route reassignments. client got a 429 and headers showed the per-route bucket remaining=0, limit=20, bucket-id changed between requests. expected behaviour? should SDK treat this as hard 429 that it never retries, or should it attempt short backoff and retry if bucket moved?

dan: my take — treat 429 as retryable by default if Retry-After header present or remaining==0 but limit>0. if bucket-id changed, server may be rebalancing; short backoff (jittered, <=2s) seems fine. important to include stable bucket identifier header so clients can correlate.

kevin: compatibility concern — older SDKs ignore unknown headers. we need a defensive plan so we don't break clients that don't see bucket-id. can we put necessary guidance in the 429 body too? minimal body that older clients will ignore but newer SDKs parse.

maria: +1 to body hint. propose a small, backwards-safe 429 body field: {"hint":"quota_moved","bucket":"<id>","recover_after":3} — SDKs parse recover_after or Retry-After. servers should still send Retry-After header when known.

sophie: example header/body we saw in repro: 
```http
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 3
X-Per-Route-Bucket: route-az1-45af
X-Per-Route-Limit: 20
X-Per-Route-Remaining: 0
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "error": "rate_limited",
  "hint": "quota_moved",
  "bucket": "route-az1-45af",
  "recover_after": 3
}
```

dan: that looks good. two ops notes: 1) make sure we only emit bucket IDs that are opaque (no internal cluster info), 2) don't spam recover_after across retries — keep linear/backoff policy server-side too.

kevin: SDK changes: expose raw headers + body hint in Response object, plus a helper RetryPolicy.retry429(response) returning boolean and suggested delay. default behavior: bubble 429 to app, but easy opt-in autoRetry with max attempts=2 and jitter. does that sound acceptable?

maria: yep. also recommend adding an integration test that simulates bucket hop during a client's burst to ensure SDKs don't loop.

sophie: sounds like consensus. action items:
- dan: add SDK helper + docs for opt-in autoRetry and show example using Retry-After or recover_after (owner) :point_right:
- infra: ensure bucket IDs are opaque and short (decomposed) — raising infra ticket if not already done
- qa: add e2e that reproduces bucket reassignment during burst

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy for infra changes (bucket metadata) at 2026-03-18 02:00 UTC — will post canary results.

dan: I'll PR the SDK helper today and add examples in docs. ping @sophie for review.

sophie: thanks all :thumbsup: — will follow up in a quick doc with examples + sample curl/response and add to the rate-limit guidance page.

kevin: one last nit — update the client guidelines to recommend exponential jitter: base=0.5s, cap=4s. prefer that to blind linear retries.

sophie: noted, will include.

maria: marking this resolved for now, reopen if we see unexpected client loops in canary. :white_check_mark:
